rules.label: Free care (<=100% FPL)
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is at or below 100% of the FPL are eligible to receive free care.

rules.label: Up to 80% discount (100-125% FPL)
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 100% and below 125% of the FPL would be eligible for up to an 80% discount.

rules.label: Up to 60% discount (125-150% FPL)
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 125% and below 150% of the FPL would be eligible for up to a 60% discount.

rules.label: Up to 40% discount (150-200% FPL)
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 150% and below 200% of the FPL would be eligible for up to a 40% discount.

rules.label: Up to 20% discount (200-250% FPL)
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 200% and below 250% of the FPL would be eligible for up to a 20% discount.

notes: The policy states that patients with income exceeding 250% FPL may be considered for financial assistance on a case-by-case basis for catastrophic illness or medical indigence at the discretion of RGH.

The policy excludes physician fees or other charges from non-employee providers such as Rocky Mountain Radiology, Aurora Denver Cardiology, Urology Associates, North Colorado Springs Foot Clinic, San Luis Valley Health, and Dr. Matthew K. Chang.
The policy states that no extraordinary collection action will be taken before 182 days from the first bill for self-pay accounts.

The policy states that RGH will refrain from initiating Extraordinary Collection Actions (ECA) for Emergency Care provided by RGH, including Emergency and Inpatient care and all attached emergency care including ancillary services such as laboratory, imaging and pharmacy.
The policy provides a sliding fee schedule with specific dollar amounts for different FPL ranges, though the vocabulary only supports percentage-based discounts.
